decision.choice: One new private C-only, allocation-free, one-shot complete SHA-256 routine derived from the explicitly pinned ordinary-buffer C fixture algorithm; it is NOT the frozen fixture function renamed or designated production.

algorithm_reference.limited_reuse: Reuse the literal standard SHA-256 initial words, 64 round constants, big-endian word loading, message schedule and compression/padding algorithm as the implementation reference. The fixture Hash size_t layout, unchecked accumulation/bit multiplication, by-value hash_end state copy and function bodies are NOT the new production contract.

decision.future_namespace: d4vr_osw_source_sha256_v1 and d4vr_osw_sha256_workspace_v1; private C linkage, no PE export or application entry point.

The observed proton projectors and observed shader bridge call the same private C routine. No second core/context or shader-library state; no inclusion of a fixture TU; no separately linked ordinary/legacy observer utility. This is a future link requirement, not a built target.
decision.dependencies: C11 stdint/stddef and the already frozen osw_sha256_v1 declaration only; no BCrypt/OpenSSL/provider/runtime API, allocator, filesystem, entropy, callback, logging, OS-memory probe or C++ runtime dependency for this utility.
not_claimed: Existing fixture abc check is not independent production verification.
No cryptographic certification or source-to-binary equivalence.

exact_private_API.declaration: uint32_t d4vr_osw_source_sha256_v1(const uint8_t *source, uint64_t source_bytes, d4vr_osw_sha256_workspace_v1 *workspace, osw_sha256_v1 *digest_out);
exact_private_API.return_domain: Metadata utility status U32, never original HRESULT/VkResult/BOOL/void. It cannot suppress, substitute or alter the original call or arguments.

statuses.name: OSW_SHA256_OK
statuses.meaning: Exactly source_bytes original bytes were consumed in order, one final padding sequence was applied, and all 32 output bytes were written.

statuses.name: OSW_SHA256_INVALID
statuses.meaning: Invalid structural NULL/alignment/pointer-address wrap or known overlap. No source byte read and no digest output write. Status alone does not claim a sink protocol fault.

statuses.name: OSW_SHA256_LIMIT
statuses.meaning: source_bytes exceeds1048576 or size_t/bit-length representation bound. No source byte read and no digest output write. Known original pointer/size may still be retained as incomplete Code.

statuses.name: OSW_SHA256_INTERNAL
statuses.meaning: Detected internal invariant inconsistency. No complete digest can be published; output unchanged. This is metadata failure and never an original failure return.

exact_private_API.one_shot: No public/private incremental init/update/final consumer API in this version. Internal block processing is streaming, but a caller cannot successfully finalize a prefix or reuse an accumulated state as a complete original span. Each invocation initializes its own workspace; no previous-frame/call hash cache.
exact_private_API.output_atomicity: Perform structural checks before the first workspace or output write. Compute fully into workspace state. Only after all requested bytes and final padding succeed, write the 32 digest bytes directly into caller-owned Before.Code.sha256. There is no intermediate output pointer publication and no prefix digest. The SOURCE helper sets Code presence/complete only after OK.
exact_private_API.pointer_preconditions: workspace must name an actually owned live, aligned8 writable 448-byte object and digest_out an actually owned live 32-byte output object (alignment1). These SOURCE-only ownership preconditions are not established by a NULL/nonNULL test or address arithmetic. source is a real typed C byte pointer from the retained original field, never an integer-U64 sink pointer cast back to memory.
exact_private_API.structural_checks: workspace/output must be actually owned live objects before entering the utility; structural checks do not prove that ownership. Before first writes or source reads, check their nonNULL/alignment and uintptr_t end additions, output/workspace disjointness, source_bytes limits and size_t representation. When source_bytes==0, take an explicit branch that performs NO source pointer arithmetic, conversion-to-dereference, subtraction, memcpy or source access, whether sourceNULL or a nonNULL observed unused value. When count>0, check source!=NULL, uintptr_t source+count nonwrapping and source span disjointness before any byte read. This is not a general memory readability test or exception-recovery promise.
exact_private_API.original_nullable_vs_unknown: Required original fixed operands pointer/count must be genuinely observed even when numeric0; unread fixed fields cannot be fabricated asNULL0. A safely observed Code.pointer and Code.bytes can be retained even if byte hashing is unsafe/oversize/unavailable. Its optional derived sha is then unknown and complete=false. sourceNULL,count0 is a known-empty utility input with no source arithmetic, not a substitute for missing observation. It adds no positive relation.
exact_private_API.status_precedence: First validate actual SOURCE-owned workspace/output object preconditions (these cannot be proved arithmetically); structural workspace/output NULL/alignment/wrap/overlap yieldsINVALID. Then source_bytes cap/representation yieldsLIMIT. Then, for count>0 only, sourceNULL/address-wrap/overlap yieldsINVALID. Count0 skips source arithmetic and every source dereference. OK is possible only after full hashing. INTERNAL only for a detected impossible algorithm invariant. No invalid output span is written.

algorithm_behavior.complete_span: Consume bytes [source, source+source_bytes) exactly once in increasing order, including every byte of a non-multiple64 tail. No first256, sample, truncation, reinterpretation, SPIR-V decoding, DXBC checksum substitution or raw-payload retention.
algorithm_behavior.maximum_padding_work: At most source_bytes/64 full data blocks plus two final blocks. No padding byte contributes to original source_bytes. Final original-bit-length is source_bytes*8, checked before computation and encoded as 64-bit big-endian.
algorithm_behavior.math: uint32_t compression additions wrap modulo2^32. Rotation counts are fixed literal values in1..31; no shift by0 or32. Schedule indices remain0..63; block byte indices0..63; used is0..63 before appending. The fixture constants and initial words remain literal pinned algorithm inputs, not source provenance.
algorithm_behavior.known_empty: The utility may compute the SHA-256 empty-span digest without dereferencing source. Its exact raw digest is the algorithm empty-message result. No new root/module/shader-positive condition follows.
algorithm_behavior.status_failure: On non-OK, digest_out remains unchanged and no complete=true/sha-present claim may be made. If the actual original code pointer+size and enclosing fixed descriptor were safely observed, retain them unchanged as Code.complete=false, sha256=null; this is a valid diagnostic, not automatic NO_PAYLOAD. Only missing/unsafe mandatory fixed original fields or an actual sink/producer protocol fault require NO_PAYLOAD. Never alter original pointer/length or replay an original to obtain readable bytes.
algorithm_behavior.no_hash_cache: RootCreate and RootParse each hash their own actual retained original occurrence; PSO VS/PS each hash their own original span; every ModuleCreate hashes its actual code span. Same address/size/hash does not allow reusing a prior digest or joining origins. Observed mutable input changes can make histories inconsistent/unknown.

source_read_order.admission: Compile-OFF evaluates no new utility call or borrowed field. ON first performs SOURCE membership/classification and successful selected enter admission with may_project_before1, before dereferencing descriptor/code operands. Hashing is part of that helper before before_commit and before its corresponding original delegate. No metadata lock is held during hashing or during the original.
source_read_order.lifetime: The same SOURCE owner thread holds the source-specific valid stable-borrow precondition for the entire helper. No original or user callback is called by the digest routine. A concurrent terminal observer fault can revoke publication, not retroactively unread bytes; existing selected ENTRY authorization permits completion of this bounded source-owned helper while its borrow is valid. before_commit revalidates token/phase; refusal discards metadata. No promise that concurrent mutation of caller storage is made safe.
source_read_order.no_return_hash: No Code bytes are read at original RETURN, after source owner free/release, during Seal/Acquire/Copy or from sink U64 fields. RootParse AFTER copies typed description through R1 fresh return admission before transfer/conversion/free; that is a separate bounded POD projection, not a delayed bytecode hash.
source_read_order.failure_inputs: An original that later fails may still have valid observed BEFORE pointer/count and fixed descriptor fields. Their code-byte borrow may independently be unavailable. Known pointer/count with failed/oversize/unavailable digest stays Code.completefalse/shaunknown, without a payload fault solely for hash failure. Unsafe/missing fixed descriptor or pointer/count observation instead follows mandatory-projection NO_PAYLOAD. A later successful original is never used retrospectively as proof that an earlier typed read was safe.
source_read_order.original_invariance: Metadata statuses are separate; every actual original, return value, output and cleanup remains exactly forwarded once. No dispatch mask, caller bytes, argument pointer/count or source lifetime is modified for capture.
